title: Slash header
description: A fixed two-tier top: a thin slate news bar with a brushed-metal glint and a nudging 'read more' arrow, over a translucent black nav with a hairline under it — serif wordmark left, six centred links (chevrons on menu links), a text link and a hairline pill right. Phones fold the links into a burger panel. A round back-to-top button rises in after the first screen.
notes: fixed by default: the section under it should leave 100px on desktop (92px on phones) of top space; `fixed={false}` puts it in the flow
the back-to-top fade uses a CSS scroll timeline; without support it is simply shown
the phone menu is a details disclosure: no JavaScript
name: slash-header

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the company name, set as a serif wordmark

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the wordmark (optional)

props.name: announcement
props.description: the news line in the thin bar above the nav; leave out to drop the bar

props.name: signIn
props.description: the quiet text link on the right ("Log in")

props.name: action
props.description: the outline pill on the right

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: accessible name of the phone menu button

props.name: toTopLabel
props.description: accessible name of the floating back-to-top button; leave out to drop it

props.name: fixed
props.description: fixed to the top of the window (the original), or in the flow
